verdict.rationale: Docs show rail-specific transaction objects (ACH, wire, book transfer, FedNow) with status fields, return/decline codes, and webhook events that could be used as building blocks for enriched transaction data, but there is no explicit documentation of counterparty detail fields, stable transaction identifiers, or a dedicated enrichment layer that turns raw feed data into product-ready metadata. Missing for 10: explicit counterparty/party detail schema, documented stable IDs across objects, and a described enrichment feature (e.g., merchant/category tagging) beyond raw status/return codes.
